DLC2314:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...A meeting of minds... Feelings conveyed without words... That's the ideal, but conversation is still the foundation of communication.」

DLC2314:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The story I'm about to tell takes place after the battle with $$クーゲル$$'s fleet in the $$霧の海$$ had settled down.」

DLC2314:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$レド$$ had begun walking a new path in life, but that road may be far steeper and longer than the life of nothing but battle he knew before.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:5.en:
$$エイミー$$
「What's wrong, $$レド$$?! Is that... lipstick on your face...?!」

DLC2314:3:t_2:6.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Guess it really was too much excitement for him.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:8.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Yeah. Once we've finished taking in the people from $$クーゲル$$'s fleet, I figured we'd have another party...」

DLC2314:3:t_2:9.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「So I sent him to get some barbecue sauce from that iron-and-steel old hag.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:10.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「You sent $$レド$$ to a place like that?!」

DLC2314:3:t_2:12.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Come on, don't be like that. It's a learning experience.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:13.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「$$レド$$'s going to live in this fleet eventually. He ought to know about $$ガルガンティア$$'s dark side, too.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「A question for you. By $$ガルガンティア$$'s dark side, do you mean the district inhabited by those physically imposing women?」

DLC2314:3:t_2:15.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Your analytical skills aren't all that impressive, Tin Man. Those were men.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:17.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「That's how it is, $$レド$$. Looks like you were popular, just as I expected. Too bad for you.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:19.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hahaha! Too shocked to speak, huh?」

DLC2314:3:t_2:20.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Wait, $$ピニオン$$! Something's wrong with him!」

DLC2314:3:t_2:22.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$?! What's wrong, $$レド$$?!」

DLC2314:3:t_2:27.en: ~$$ガルガンティア船団$$ - Fleet Commander's Room~

DLC2314:3:t_2:29.en:
$$オルダム$$
「You can close your mouth now, $$レド$$.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:31.en:
$$オルダム$$
「His throat is badly inflamed. He probably already had some kind of infection, then strained his throat by shouting too much.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:32.en:
$$オルダム$$
「It's nothing life-threatening. Though he won't be able to speak for two or three days.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:33.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Thank goodness! So it's nothing serious!」

DLC2314:3:t_2:34.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「It's odd to call it good timing, but $c is investigating $$サイデリアル$$ remnants in the surrounding area.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:35.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「You were supposed to stay here and hold the fort, but you might as well enjoy a vacation.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:37.en:
$$リジット$$
「You don't look happy. But enjoying your free time is a necessary part of life, too.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:38.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「That's right. $$リジット$$ may look stiff and proper, but she's pretty bold in private.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:39.en:
$$リジット$$
「Keep your unnecessary comments to yourself...!」

DLC2314:3:t_2:41.en:
$$エイミー$$
「And you can't go thinking weird things either, $$レド$$.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:43.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Well... Looks like $$リジット$$ isn't $$レド$$'s type, either.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:45.en:
$$エイミー$$
「What's wrong, $$チェインバー#pilot$$?」

DLC2314:3:t_2:46.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$ is currently unable to speak. Yet you are communicating with him.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:47.en:
$$オルダム$$
「When you understand what someone is like, even a small gesture can tell you a lot about what they're thinking.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:48.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Not that a tin can like you could do it.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:49.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I am compelled to agree.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:50.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「This is no time to lounge around!」

DLC2314:3:t_2:52.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「My scouts have contacted me. A $$サイデリアル$$ unit is approaching this fleet.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:54.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「It's no use. The enemy will arrive first.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:57.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You can't, $$レド$$! You can't give $$チェインバー#pilot$$ any instructions!」

DLC2314:3:t_2:59.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I get how determined you are. But leave this to me.」

DLC2314:3:t_2:61.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「It's my fault you lost your voice in the first place.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:4.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「A lot happened, but at least it's all settled now.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:5.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ attacking is one thing, but you're the one who caused $$レド$$'s problem...」

DLC2314:3:t_3:6.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「And that's why I put my neck on the line and took responsibility, didn't I?」

DLC2314:3:t_3:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「Still, without $$エイミー$$ keeping you in check, I think even $$チェインバー#pilot$$ would have been in danger.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:8.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I agree with $$アルト$$. You're better suited to being a mechanic.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:9.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Wh-what...?! Are you saying I failed?!」

DLC2314:3:t_3:10.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「No. We're saying everyone has a role of their own.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:11.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「And just like that, there's a place that suits $$エイミー$$ better than fighting, too.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:12.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...Sorry, $$レド$$. I did my best, but fighting's hard...」

DLC2314:3:t_3:16.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$! Your voice is coming back!」

DLC2314:3:t_3:18.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Ah... Don't strain yourself! You're only just getting better!」

DLC2314:3:t_3:19.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But that thank you just now... It was so halting, like when we first met.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:21.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「From this point, this unit will express Ensign $$レド$$'s feelings on his behalf.」

review.context: After a prank errand, Ledo loses his voice to an inflamed throat. Amy and Pinion volunteer to command Chamber against an incoming Sidereal unit.
decisions: Pinion's revelation about the muscular men and Ledo's lipstick is retained at the source's comic strength.
Ledo's voiceless punctuation and halting returning speech are kept as distinct forms of communication.
